using UnityEngine;
internal class CommandScript : IRunCommand { public void Execute(ExecutionResult result) {Physics.SyncTransforms();var points=new[]{new Vector3(-38.39798f,100,-320.77752f),new Vector3(262.84065f,100,48.11872f),new Vector3(-309.75181f,100,54.97094f)};for(int i=0;i<points.Length;i++){var hits=Physics.RaycastAll(points[i],Vector3.down,300);result.Log("V0"+(i+1)+" hits="+hits.Length);foreach(var hit in hits){if(hit.collider==null)continue;result.Log("ground="+hit.collider.name+" y="+hit.point.y+" binding="+(hit.collider.GetComponent<CampusSim.CampusTerrainBinding>()!=null));}}}}
